Welcome to the website of the Institute of Geography, University of Bern
Founded in 1886, the Institute comprises Human Geography, Physical Geography, and Geographies of Sustainability and conducts research on all aspects of geography. The Institute offers a Bachelor and a Master program and contributes to several other study programs.
Why study Geography in Bern? You can find out what former and current students and lecturers think on the page 'For prospective students' under the heading 'Studies'.

Farewell to Prof. em. Dr. Hans Hurni
On September 27, 2026, Hans Hurni passed away at the age of 75. He was a co-founder of the Center for Development and the Environment (CDE) and, until his retirement in 2016, head of the “Land Systems and Sustainable Resource Use” research group at GIUB.
2 October 2026
Strengthening Jet Stream
The past variability of the Atlantic-European jet stream, which is related to extreme weather events in Europe, can now be better constrained thanks to a daily reconstruction reaching 300 years back in time
10 September 2026
SUI-2 coached by GIUB and ETH meteorologists won the Gordon Bennett 2026 World Championship for Gas Ballooning
Over the weekend, a team around Dr. Killian Brennan, Postdoc in Cloud Dynamics Group, supported the Command Center of the SUI-2 gas ballooning pilots at the Gordon Bennett 2026 race.
